rows.statement: Tesla claims engaging FSD lowers collision likelihood; independent report says Tesla's driverless system crashes far more than humans

sides.text: When engaged and under your active supervision, your likelihood of being in a collision goes down.
Tesla 'Robotaxi' adds 5 more crashes in Austin in a month – 4x worse than humans

rows.statement: FSD requires only minimal driver intervention

sides.text: When enabled, your vehicle will drive you almost anywhere with your active supervision, requiring minimal intervention.
Tesla Full Self Driving requires human intervention every 13 miles

rows.statement: FSD drives almost anywhere with minimal intervention

sides.text: FSD (Supervised) enables your vehicle to drive you almost anywhere with your active supervision, requiring minimal intervention.
Tesla Full Self Driving requires human intervention every 13 miles

rows.statement: FSD delivers clear and undeniable real-world safety improvement

sides.text: the magnitude of improved real-world safety using FSD (Supervised) is clear and undeniable
Tesla's Autopilot, Full Self-Driving linked to 100s of crashes, deaths

rows.statement: FSD safety benefits are established and undeniable

sides.text: The safety benefits of FSD (Supervised) are clear when compared to manually driven Tesla vehicles with and without active safety features.
US opens Tesla probe after more crashes involving its "full self-driving"

rows.statement: Tesla's driver-assistance systems set the worldwide standard for vehicle safety

sides.text: Tesla’s combination of passive, active and advanced driver-assistance safety systems set the standard for vehicle safety worldwide.
Tesla’s ‘Full Self-Driving’ Beta Software Used on Public Roads Lacks Safeguards

rows.statement: All post-2014 Tesla vehicles have AEB, FCW and lane departure warning

sides.text: All Tesla vehicles manufactured after 2014 are equipped with active safety features, including Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning and other collision-avoidance systems.

rows.statement: FSD checks blind spots and changes lanes while avoiding bikes and motorcycles

sides.text: On-board cameras with 360-degree visibility will check your blind spots and move your Tesla vehicle into a neighboring lane while maintaining your speed and avoiding bikes, motorcycles and other cars.

rows.statement: Eight external cameras give a 360-degree view

sides.text: Eight external cameras provide a 360-degree view of the environment around the vehicle.

rows.statement: Collisions within five seconds of FSD activity are counted as FSD-engaged

sides.text: If FSD (Supervised) was active at any point within five seconds leading up to a collision event, Tesla considers the collision to have occurred with FSD (Supervised) engaged

rows.statement: Teslas with active safety features have substantially higher miles-per-collision

sides.text: Tesla’s data reflects substantially higher miles-per-collision rates for Tesla vehicles equipped with active safety features compared to Tesla vehicles without these features.

rows.statement: FSD processes over one million pixels of visual data every millisecond

sides.text: The FSD (Supervised) system then processes over one million pixels of visual data every millisecond so that it can respond in real time to complex and highly variable driving environments.

rows.statement: FSD (Supervised) drives on nearly all roads under driver supervision

sides.text: FSD (Supervised) enables your vehicle to drive you almost anywhere with your active supervision, requiring minimal intervention.

customers can subscribe to an optional Level 2 package called "Full Self-Driving (Supervised)" (FSD), which adds semi-autonomous navigation on nearly all roads, self-parking, and the ability to summon the car from a parking space.

rows.statement: Tesla delivers safety fixes via over-the-air software updates

sides.text: Over-the-air software updates ensure each Tesla vehicle has access to the latest safety improvements.
Tesla has released an over-the-air (OTA) software update, free of charge.

rows.statement: FSD (Supervised) is sold as a paid subscription option

sides.text: Available for $99/mo1
customers can subscribe to an optional Level 2 package called "Full Self-Driving (Supervised)" (FSD)

rows.statement: Vehicle can be summoned via the Tesla app to navigate parking lots

sides.text: Activate in the Tesla app and your Tesla vehicle will navigate through parking lots and tight spaces to get to you.

customers can subscribe to an optional Level 2 package called "Full Self-Driving (Supervised)" (FSD), which adds semi-autonomous navigation on nearly all roads, self-parking, and the ability to summon the car from a parking space.
